verdict.rationale: First-party docs show workspace administrators can control access to ChatGPT Work, plugins, browser use, and network access, and can govern whether GPT builders use approved workspace apps or permitted third-party API actions. ChatGPT data controls are also documented as applying to processed content, which partly covers data policies. Missing for 10: any evidence of member management (inviting, removing, or assigning roles), detailed admin-console or data-retention policy documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
